assessments.reasoning: The switch flow obtains the discriminant property, locates union constituents for literal cases when possible, and otherwise filters the type based on the relevant case value. The fixtures have distinct string literals and non-fall-through returns.

The verified CLI accepted matching member reads in the two switch cases. The other member inside the first case and a member read before switching each produced TS2339. The diagnostics identify the incompatible statically known types.

challenge.method: Replayed a strict two-case switch and attempted the wrong property inside a case and a variant member read before narrowing.
challenge.results: The scoped switch succeeded. Both challenge cases returned TS2339.

limitations: The scope is static checking of a plain two-variant union. Run-time validation, exhaustiveness enforcement for other switches, and mutable or aliased discriminants are separate claims.
